description: Defines the class PdfUIntegerObject, representing an (obsolete) class for handling 32-bit unsigned integers within the PDFsharp library. The class includes constructors, a property for the value, and a method for writing the object to a PDF writer.

classes.name: PdfUIntegerObject
classes.description: An obsolete, sealed class representing an unsigned 32-bit integer object in a PDF document.

methods.name: PdfUIntegerObject()
methods.description: Default constructor creating a new instance without an initial value.

methods.name: PdfUIntegerObject(uint value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with an unsigned 32-bit integer value.

methods.name: PdfUIntegerObject(PdfDocument document, uint value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with a document context and a value.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the unsigned integer value.

methods.name: WriteObject(PdfWriter writer)
methods.description: Writes the object to a PDF writer, including proper object boundaries.
